name: Iowa Plates: Restaurants
subtitle: Tenderloins & Loose Meats
description:
Iowa's restaurants, from breaded pork tenderloins that hang far past the bun to the loose-meat counters of Muscatine, Marshalltown and Sioux City.

Iowa Plates is a free guide to eating in Iowa: 9 breaded pork tenderloins from the Iowa Pork Producers Association's contest, 3 loose-meat counters, 9 Iowa pizzerias and 6 heritage-town tables we checked by hand, plus 6,739 restaurants, cafés, bars and bakeries in 626 towns, from Des Moines and Cedar Rapids to Davenport, Iowa City and Sioux City. No account, no ads.

IOWA GUIDES
• Pork Tenderloins: finalists and winners of the pork producers' 2025 and 2026 breaded tenderloin contests.
• Loose-Meat Sandwiches: loose-meat counters from Muscatine to Sioux City.
• Iowa Pizza: taco pizza, Quad Cities-style pizza and thin-crust favorites.
• Heritage Tables: the Amana Colonies, Pella, Orange City, Elk Horn and Cedar Rapids's Czech Village.
• James Beard Honors: 8 honored Iowa restaurants.

FIND IT FAST
• Sort by distance, or browse the map by guide.
• Search by name, town, street or dish: "tenderloin", "loose meat", "taco pizza".
• Filter by town or cuisine, or hide chains.
• Save places, and find hand-checked places from iPhone search (Spotlight).

LIVE DETAILS FROM APPLE MAPS
Tap "Ratings, hours & photos" on any place to open Apple Maps' own place card, with current hours, photos, ratings and directions.

HOW THE LISTS ARE BUILT
Every guide place was checked by hand in fall 2026 against a dated 2025 or 2026 source: the pork producers' contest pages, Travel Iowa's own listings or local news. The rest come from Overture Maps open data, kept only when the listing is high-confidence. Iowa posts its inspection reports only on the state's own search page, so the app shows no inspection results and links to that search instead; it computes no grades. Website links are checked too. Nothing is ranked by star ratings. Newer restaurant data downloads from the Iowa Plates website when there is some.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your location, if you share it, only sorts lists on your device. Saved places stay on your device.

Places open and close, so check before you go. Spot a mistake? Email nick@eatsranked.com.

An independent app, not affiliated with any restaurant, chain or government agency (including the State of Iowa or the Iowa Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing), Travel Iowa or any visitor bureau, the Iowa Pork Producers Association, or the James Beard Foundation. James Beard Foundation and James Beard Award are trademarks of the James Beard Foundation. Place data from Overture Maps Foundation (CDLA Permissive 2.0) and others; sources and licenses are on the About tab.

reviewNotes:
1. Purpose and audience: Iowa Plates is a free guide to restaurants in Iowa (the U.S. state). Its focus is the state's own food: breaded pork tenderloins, loose-meat sandwiches, Iowa pizza and the heritage towns' tables, 28 places checked by hand in fall 2026 against a 2025 or 2026 source, plus the James Beard honorees. It also lists 6,739 restaurants, cafés and bars in 626 towns from open map data. It is for residents and visitors deciding where to eat, with no ads, account or tracking.

2. How to use it (no login, no setup, no sample files needed):
- Home → Pork Tenderloins (or Loose-Meat Sandwiches, Iowa Pizza, Heritage Tables, James Beard Honors, Near Me) → tap any place.
- On a place, tap "Ratings, hours & photos" to open Apple Maps' own place card through MapKit. Directions, Call and Website are below it. Iowa publishes inspection reports only on its own search page, so each place links to that search; the app shows no inspection results or grades.
- Search from the Home search box by name, town, street or dish ("tenderloin", "loose meat", "taco pizza").
- The Map tab shows each guide as pins. "My location" and the Nearest sort use location only if allowed, on the device.
- The heart saves a place on the device (Saved tab). The About tab lists the sources, licenses and the independence statement.
- On iPad, a sidebar replaces the tabs; a place opens in the right-hand column.
- Location: if you're outside Iowa (as App Review usually is), the map says so and stays on Iowa, and distance sorting still works from where you are.
- "Iowa Plates" is the Home Screen name of "Iowa Plates: Restaurants".

3. External services and data:
- Apple MapKit: maps, local search to find a place's Apple Maps listing, and Apple's place card for live hours, photos and ratings.
- Core Location: optional, on-device only, for distance sorting.
- Data updates: at most once a day, the app checks the Iowa Plates website (static files on GitHub Pages) for newer restaurant data and downloads it if there is some. The requests carry no identifiers or location.
- No backend, accounts, analytics, advertising, payments or AI services. The restaurant data is bundled in the app.
- Bundled data sources: Overture Maps Foundation open place data (CDLA Permissive 2.0 and others; license texts are in the app); James Beard Foundation honors (facts only); and our own research of public websites, local news and visitor-bureau pages.
- The website with the privacy policy and support page is static and hosted on GitHub Pages: https://nickstrom5.github.io/iowa-eats/

4. Regional differences: none. The content covers Iowa; the app is offered in the United States and works the same everywhere.

5. Regulated or protected material: the app is not in a regulated industry and includes no protected third-party material. The data is open-licensed or public record, with attribution in the app.
